<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Move messages out of the inbox to the account's archive. Refs come from the arguments, or one per line on stdin when the only argument is -.

## Usage

```text
chainmail archive <ref>...
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail archive cm1:work:INBOX:7:42
# archive everything a search finds
chainmail search from:newsletter --output json | jq -r '.rows[].ref' | chainmail archive -
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
